title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：twin　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 twin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the grandmother ① knew the twin that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the knowing was the whole of the year. The ② twin, meaning the sibling itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a twin, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ twin in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ twin at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A twin, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the twin was the whole of the matter, meaning the bond and not the sibling. The ⑥ twin, meaning the bond and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; twin, he said, is either something you know or the only word that means both a sibling and a bond. He said the bond is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ twin had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ twin of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; twin, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ twin I remember is the sibling recorded in the diary, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ twin, my mother said in 1981, is the only sibling that improves by being recorded; every twin, she said, is a bond that has agreed to look like a sibling. She said the bond was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 双胞胎之一（指院子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 双胞胎之一（指那个双胞胎之一本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：know the twin 认这一个双胞胎之一
D. n. 双胞胎之一（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 双胞胎之一之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的双胞胎之一之事）
F. n. 双胞胎之一（指日记里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 双胞胎之一、牵系（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 牵系（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: knew the twin that no child in the courtyard would have recorded
The twin, meaning the sibling itself and not the lamp
the twin at the far window

answers.why: know the twin 意为“认这一个双胞胎之一”，1972 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一个双胞胎之一做了一遍。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一”，指那个双胞胎之一本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一”，指院子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一、牵系”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个牵系就是那件事的全部。
twin 意为“牵系”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个双胞胎之一，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一”，指日记里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1977 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的双胞胎之一之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
twin 意为“双胞胎之一”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一个，1979 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一个。
twin 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，双胞胎之一是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的双胞胎之一。
